title: search in

query.description: Text to find. Use exactly one of query, id or recent=true.

id.description: Read one complete host note, including visible supersession. Use exactly one selector; old integer IDs belong to legacy get.

recent.description: Set true to enumerate recent relevant notes without reinforcement. False is refused; use exactly one selector.

selection.description: Relevant combines current-task, explicit project-wide and reusable notes. Legacy selects unscoped compatibility notes. The host derives project/task; callers cannot supply their identifiers.

limit.description: Maximum results for query or recent; unavailable with id.

exact.description: Exact word matching, available only with query.

description: Exactly one of query, id or recent=true is required. This cross-field requirement is checked by the operation; all argument types and bounds are declared here.
